build_SqueezeExcitation_2d: build a SqueezeExcitation block for 2D tensors with 256 channels and a reduction ratio of 16
build_SqueezeExcitation_3d: build a SqueezeExcitation block for 3D tensors with 128 channels using a custom activation function
build_SpatialSqueezeExcitation: build a SpatialSqueezeExcitation block for 2D tensors with 64 channels to squeeze channel-wise and excite spatially
build_ChannelSpatialSqueezeExcitation: build a ChannelSpatialSqueezeExcitation block that combines channel and spatial squeeze excitation for 256 channels
run_SqueezeExcitation_forward: run the forward pass of a SqueezeExcitation block on a batch of 2D input tensors
